summary: Calderon et al. 2022 (Science), sci-RNA-seq3 of nuclei from wild-type (Canton S) embryos collected in 11 overlapping windows spanning 0-20 h (GEO GSE190147, the RNA SubSeries of GSE190149); replaces the old FlyBase load FBlc0007797 with fresh VFBseq ids. 11 Samples (collection windows) / 41 Assays (experiment x window). 11 Clusterings: the authors' clusters in 9 modelled 2-hour windows of nuclear age (0-18 h, NNv1; Table S1, 268 clusters; Cluster stage from the window where a narrow FBdv term fits) and their neuroectoderm (20) and mature-neuron (11) re-clusterings: 223 loaded (embryonic / embryonic-larval / late-embryonic larval cell terms and somatic cell terms of primordia), 76 held. Summary expression as CPM from the GEO count matrix (17,864 genes x 532,059 nuclei).

decisions.decision: Map to cell-level FBbt terms only (a tissue or organ author term maps to its cell-level equivalent, else the type is held).
Clusters with no FBbt term are held: listed in mapping.tsv with a hold_reason but not loaded (no VFBseq id, entity or expression rows). Their cells still count towards the Dataset's gene counts.
Summary expression is computed as CPM for every dataset.

Narrow a generic type by the dissected tissue only where the tissue makes the tissue-specific FBbt term exact; hold clusters that could only be typed as cell or neuron (or stage-specific versions); load glia under a glial-cell term.

Load the paper's main clustering: nuclei binned by the authors' NNv1 age estimate into 2-hour windows, each clustered and annotated by hand (Table S1); the 18-20 h window left out, as in the paper (model edge effects); plus both neuronal re-clusterings (neuroectoderm sub-clusters and mature-neuron sub-sub-clusters) as further Clusterings.

One Sample per collection window (the supplementary methods: each window's nuclei isolated as a batch, drawn on by several sci-RNA-seq experiments), one Assay per experiment x window; GSMs are PCR wells, not Samples. Stage: the narrowest FBdv term covering the window's stages; tissue embryo; Canton S, no stock named (not linked). Each Clustering linked to the collection windows giving at least 1% of its nuclei (thin tails of likely mis-aged nuclei from distant collections).

Cluster stage from the modelled window (the nuclei's ages come from their own transcriptomes) where an FBdv term narrower than embryonic stage covers it; none for the neuronal re-clusterings (6-18 h pooled).

Clusters by build_clusters.py from the authors' per-window Seurat objects (export_windows.R, base R; all 9 windows match Table S1's cluster counts) and Table S1 annotations, and the portal's neuronal annotation files; one spelling variant of spiracle (tracheal system) unified.

Mapping per author type: embryonic, embryonic/larval or (late embryo) larval cell terms; primordia and anlagen to the somatic cell terms of those structures. Brain to larval CNS neuron, at 10-14 h immature primary neuron; ventral nerve cord to larval CNS neuron; brain / VNC primordium and Neural progenitors to embryonic neuroblast (broad); Immature neurons to immature primary neuron; PNS to larval PNS neuron, PNS / sensory nervous system primordia to peripheral sensory precursor cell, sensory nervous system to embryonic/larval sensory neuron; hindgut / anal pad to somatic cell of embryonic/larval hindgut, foregut / hindgut (/ anal pad) to somatic cell of ectoderm (broad); Malpighian tubule to embryonic specialized Malpighian tubule cell (16-18 h embryonic/larval); spiracle to larval tracheocyte (broad); yolk nuclei to yolk nucleus; neurotransmitter and chordotonal neurons to the larval terms; Germline to germline cell. Held (no term): anlage in statu nascendi, cellular blastoderm / pole cell, Head epid. /muscle, Undiff., Chordotonal glia, Ventral midline.

Expression from the GEO count matrix (UMI counts, all nuclei), as CPM; gene symbols mapped to current FlyBase genes (17,784 current, 81 secondary, 2 synonym); transposable-element features (FBti, RR...) and 485 miRNA transcripts named by FBtr id dropped.
All 299 mapping.tsv rows reviewed by the curator (8 on 2026-10-18, the rest 2026-10-19).

checks.check: Per-window cluster counts in the authors' Seurat objects against Table S1.
GEO matrix column order against GEO's per-nucleus nCount_RNA; most-counted genes.
checks.result: Column sums equal nCount_RNA; top genes plausible (eEF1alpha1, mt:lrRNA, roX1, Hsromega).

checks.check: verify_mappings.py: every FBbt term in the mappings looked up in OLS (FBbt 2026-10-01).
checks.result: 52 terms current, not obsolete, labels match.

checks.check: FBbt, FBdv and FBcv terms on the Samples, Assays, Clusters and Dataset looked up in OLS.
Most cluster-specific genes per author type in the expression output.
checks.result: Fit the types (somatic muscle Mhc / up / sls; tracheal system Osiris genes; plasmatocytes Ppn / Col4a1 / Pxn; germ cells CycB / me31B; yolk nuclei apolpp; glia wrapper; cholinergic cac / Sh / para).
